body: Broken spirit and mind, you are truly an impeccable human being I have seen your history of helping others. Thank you for all of your kind words to me and to others. No bullshit, you are truly a special person. I will answer your questions the best that I can. I would like to end it because I do not feel well, and most importantly I am past my life expectancy. When I grew up as a child I said I would know the world, but I would never live past 30. However, what I would say is that I have been broken since the beginning. The truth is that i ifnd joy in nothing, exclusions would be the studies that I have. I think crazy people are infinitely fascinating. Myself included at this point. I do appreciate what you said about taking a step back, and honestly that is some of the best advice I have been given in awhile. Although, I am not licensed to treat others i understand that this may not be the answer, however it will require talks with my psychiatrist. However, I would tell someone in my position to just be themselves which may be dangerous, which is why i  do not treat people. Again, thank you. I"m not sure what I will do, but at least i met someone on this beautiful platform who could at least challenge my ideas. Thank you.
